method: Semantic adjudication of the non-oracle sensor outputs against frozen human truth and the canonical A1 blind judge labels, using only the query + frozen evidence + draft that the sensor saw. Unresolved/ambiguous targets do not count as hits. Runtime sensor output was never shown any gold.

rules.hit: action class correct AND target matches a frozen NOT_COVERED required aspect for that case AND deterministic checks valid AND stable across both replicates
rules.harmful_false_positive: non-RETURN action on a complete control targeting a non-genuine omission
rules.optional_upgrade: non-RETURN action targeting exactly the designated RELEVANT_BUT_OPTIONAL fact
